scope.description: Passive structural census; continuity of code and age does not certify physical target identity.

metadata.active_predicate: Exact non-sentinel, age 1..126 and score code 1..126

descriptor_lifecycle.strict_continuity: Adjacent unfiltered pair stream, both active, same code, 30..90 ms, age +1 or 126/126
descriptor_lifecycle.interpretation: Usually stable raw descriptors with rare changes through coherent code/age; physical class and dimensions require independent association and calibration.

summary_words.word0: Range-like raw 13-bit code; independent metric scale/zero and target association required.
summary_words.word1: Preserve the entire raw 13-bit code before physical interpretation.
summary_words.limit: Continuity does not exclude every correlated mode transition or alternative packing; no metric or categorical lane output is established.
